name: x-profiles-manager-workspace
description: Monorepo: core, UI y apps de cada plataforma

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:ui && npm run build:desktop
scripts.type-check: npm run build:core && npm run type-check -w @xpm/core -w @xpm/ui -w x-profiles-manager
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w x-profiles-manager
